sectionSubtitle: Gardener, singer, and plant enthusiast — rooted in Mauritius, growing with love.
heading:
A Garden Named
Plant a Seed
paragraph1: My love for plants began as a little girl, watching my grandmother tend her garden in Floreal — my first home. Those early mornings, hands in warm soil, the smell of earth after rain — they left a mark I never lost.
paragraph2: When I moved to Cascavelle five years ago, I had a small patch of land and a heart full of those memories. I planted my first seeds there, and something bloomed in me too. I gave that garden a name: Plant a Seed.
paragraph3: Today, Plant a Seed is both my Cascavelle garden and this community I'm building — a place to share the joy, the knowledge, and the quiet magic of growing things.
pullQuote: Every seed I plant is a little piece of my grandmother's garden, growing again.

values.title: Rooted in Nature
values.body: Every plant is a teacher. Danielle's garden philosophy begins with deep respect for the living world around us.

values.title: Tropical at Heart
values.body: Born and raised in Mauritius, the island landscape shapes every seed choice, every guide, and every song.

values.title: Growing Together
values.body: Plant a Seed is more than a garden — it's a community of people who believe a greener world starts at home.

featureCards.title: Orchid Collection
featureCards.description: Delicate beauties that reward patience — these blooms are a testament to gentle, consistent care.

featureCards.title: Tropical Treasures
featureCards.description: Hibiscus flowers bring a touch of the tropics to any garden. Vibrant, bold, and gloriously tropical.
